scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && tsc && vite build
scripts.build:wasm: cd ../crypto && wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir ../frontend/src/wasm-pkg && cd ../bitboard-encryption && wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir ../frontend/src/wasm-pkg/bitboard_encryption && cd ../bitboard-lightning && wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir ../frontend/src/wasm-pkg/bitboard_lightning && cd ../bitboard-arkade && wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir ../frontend/src/wasm-pkg/bitboard_arkade && cd ../bitboard-bark && wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir ../frontend/src/wasm-pkg/bitboard_bark
scripts.regtest:clean-start: npm run regtest:clean && npm run regtest:start
scripts.test:e2e:regtest: REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 npm run regtest:clean-start && REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 playwright test --grep @regtest
scripts.test:e2e:arkade-regtest: REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 npm run regtest:clean-start && REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 VITE_E2E_ARKADE_REGTEST=true playwright test --grep @arkade-regtest
scripts.regtest:bark-clean-start: npm run regtest:clean && npm run regtest:bark-start
scripts.test:e2e:bark-regtest: REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 REQUIRE_BARK_REGTEST=1 npm run regtest:bark-clean-start && REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 REQUIRE_BARK_REGTEST=1 VITE_E2E_BARK_REGTEST=true BARK_REGTEST_EXPORT_BOARDED_FIXTURE=1 playwright test --grep @bark-regtest
scripts.test:e2e:bark-exit-regtest: BARK_CAPTAIND_TOML=docker/captaind/captaind.exit.toml REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 REQUIRE_BARK_REGTEST=1 npm run regtest:bark-clean-start && REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 REQUIRE_BARK_REGTEST=1 VITE_E2E_BARK_REGTEST=true playwright test --grep @bark-exit-regtest
scripts.test:e2e:bark-refresh-regtest: BARK_CAPTAIND_TOML=docker/captaind/captaind.refresh.toml REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 REQUIRE_BARK_REGTEST=1 npm run regtest:bark-clean-start && REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 REQUIRE_BARK_REGTEST=1 VITE_E2E_BARK_REGTEST=true playwright test --grep @bark-refresh-regtest
scripts.test:e2e:arkade-regtest-longexpiry: ARKD_VTXO_TREE_EXPIRY=200 REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 npm run regtest:clean-start && REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 VITE_E2E_ARKADE_REGTEST=true playwright test --grep @arkade-exit-regtest
scripts.test:e2e:arkade-regtest-reg04: ARKD_VTXO_TREE_EXPIRY=200 REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 npm run regtest:clean-start && REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 VITE_E2E_ARKADE_REGTEST=true playwright test --grep @arkade-reg04
scripts.test:e2e:arkade-regtest-reg07: ARKD_VTXO_TREE_EXPIRY=200 REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 npm run regtest:clean-start && REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 VITE_E2E_ARKADE_REGTEST=true playwright test --grep @arkade-reg07
scripts.test:e2e:arkade-regtest-signer: ARKD_VTXO_TREE_EXPIRY=200 REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 npm run regtest:clean-start && REQUIRE_ARKADE_REGTEST=1 VITE_E2E_ARKADE_REGTEST=true playwright test --grep @arkade-signer-regtest
